notes.title: Update Ver 1.1.0.5 Teleport Back in New Modes
notes.notes:
Now locomotion is optional in multi-player mode and infinite mode, which means you can choose either teleport or free locomotion before the game starts:).  

We also think it is somehow weird to put two types of movements together in one game, yet we could not figure out better solution for now in a short time. We'd be really interested in getting to know how you guys think of the this update, and any new thought will be so much welcomed.

Other changes:

  Leaderboard and server data zeroed.

notes.title: Enmergency Update 1.1.0.1---Crashes Fixed and Movement Coming Next Week!
notes.notes:
Hey folks, 

Plz download and install this update immediately, if you met a crash. 

Believe it or not, the last thing we want is to let you down in this version:(, we are really happy and feel lucky to have you guys in the community for last 4 months.  And these two day we've been trying very hard to test and solve the crash and server problems. 

It is a relief for me that we worked the problem out today, so update it immediately, hope now you can do fine with the game.

There would probably be another update by tomorrow, to further fix the connection and stability.

 About Movement	

We finally worked out a nice way to manage a free trackpad/thumb stick locomotion. Will be applied in next week's update very soon!

notes.title: Coming Soon on 17 April! New Trailer Update.
notes.notes:
Actually this is more of a delay announcement...ːsteamboredː 

15 April was our original full release date, and also a date to increase the price. Now we just need to delay it for 2 days.  Since Easter is not an conditional holiday here, we think we can still have some time to test the PVP mode repeatedly before Monday :), then release with more certainty.

Please notice that the price will still be increased on 15 April. And I'd love to share two additional news of the coming version:

1. Optimization for Oculus Users Done . Rotation for facing direction 
    added, 
    will be more fair on cross-platform competition;

2. Save Points Added . There will be several saving opportunities in easy 
    and middle difficulties.

You could see most new features in our latest trailer I just uploaded.

notes.title: Important Notice: Permanent Price Raise for Full Release Version after 15 April
notes.notes:
As we'd mentioned in Early Access Q&As before:

 it is not our best choice, however we are going to rise the price to $24.99 , due to tons of stuffs added to the game, and somehow cover the cost of PVP online server.

Notice:

 You can still enjoy a (kinda) early bird discount from now on before 15 April, 
     at current price $19.99;

 Again no influence to those who'd already bought the game;

 Have a nice weekend :p!

notes.title: Upgraded new version, optimized fluency and also the Blink!
notes.notes:
We think we found the cause why some players got  framerate problem. This upgrade probably could solve it totally. 

We also modified the cool down time for Locomotion, we added 3 blink power bars to it, every blink would cost 1 bar, the bars is recharging over time, so you can plan how to use the moving chance with strategy.

We are going to make upgrades every week until the final version come, suggestions are always welcomed anytime. 

Thanks again for liking the demo!

notes.title: New version updated yesterday morning. Fixed some bugs.
notes.notes:
New version updated. Fixed some bugs 
Sorry for the not so fluent playing experience for some players. We worked on optimization all this weekend and finally made an improved version. Hope it can solve the problem somehow. We are still collecting the feedbacks and trying to update another version asap to totally improve the performance. 

Thank you all for liking the demo, we hate to let you down, and hope the final version of this game can surprise you.
